# maxcloud.yaml

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from [`maxcloud.schema.json`](../../maxcloud.schema.json)._

An app on maxcloud: the whole app's definition, like a wrangler.toml. mcloud deploy keeps the app's registry entry in line with it, and for a GitOps app a push does too (quota, buckets, db and domains). Fields left out keep what the entry has, or the defaults. What each field is for: [maxcloud.yaml](../maxcloud-yaml.md).

For completion and checking in an editor with the YAML language server, start the file with:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxemiliang/maxcloud/main/maxcloud.schema.json
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | string, required |  | The app's name: its namespace, and part of its hostnames (&lt;service&gt;--&lt;app&gt;.gronblom.dev) and bucket names (mc-&lt;app&gt;--&lt;bucket&gt;). Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, starting with a letter, at most 30 characters. Platform namespaces (flux-system, traefik, kube-\*, ...) are reserved. |
| `deploy` | string: gitops, direct | `gitops` | gitops: a push to the repo deploys, through Flux. direct: mcloud deploy builds here and applies the manifests itself, nothing from git. Changing it switches the app on the next mcloud deploy, which asks first. Left out, the app keeps its current mode (gitops for a new app), and mcloud apps set --deploy can change it; set, apps set refuses to. |
| `source` | string | `.` | The folder the app is built from and mcloud dev runs in, relative to maxcloud.yaml. A Dockerfile, project.toml and migrations/ are looked for there. A directory inside the repo, without '..'. The manifests stay at the root (path). |
| `image` | string | `registry.gronblom.dev/<app>/<app>` | Where mcloud build and local direct builds push the image, instead of the maxcloud registry; log in to it yourself. The cluster has to be able to pull from it. --build cluster refuses it and the GitOps deploy workflow ignores it: those push to the maxcloud registry. |
| `repo` | string |  | GitOps: the GitHub repo Flux deploys from, &lt;owner&gt;/&lt;repo&gt;. Default: the repo's origin remote. Ignored for direct apps. |
| `path` | string | `deploy/k8s` | GitOps: the directory of manifests in the repo that Flux applies. A relative path. Ignored for direct apps. |
| `branch` | string | `main` | GitOps: the branch Flux deploys. Ignored for direct apps. |
| `quota` | object |  | What the app's namespace may request in total. The platform caps what a developer may ask for; more takes an admin. |
| `quota.cpu` | string or number | `200m` | CPU requested by all the app's pods together, a Kubernetes quantity. E.g. `500m`, `1` |
| `quota.memory` | string | `1Gi` | Memory requested by all the app's pods together, a Kubernetes quantity. E.g. `2Gi` |
| `quota.pods` | integer or string | `20` | How many pods the app may have. |
| `buckets` | list of strings |  | The app's S3 buckets. Each becomes mc-&lt;app&gt;--&lt;name&gt;, with the app's credentials in every function's environment. Add :public to make a bucket's objects readable by anyone at https://&lt;name&gt;--&lt;app&gt;.gronblom.dev/. Removing a bucket from the list keeps it and its objects. An empty list declares that the app has none. E.g. `uploads`, `assets:public` |
| `db` | boolean or object |  | A Postgres database (CloudNativePG), backed up continuously to the bucket mc-&lt;app&gt;--db; every function gets DATABASE\_URL. true, or its settings. false removes the database and keeps its backups. |
| `db.size` | string | `1Gi` | Disk per instance, a Kubernetes quantity. Can grow, never shrink. |
| `db.instances` | integer or string: 1, 2 | `1` | 1, or 2 for a replica on the other node. |
| `domains` | list of objects |  | Hostnames of the app's own for its Knative services, besides &lt;service&gt;--&lt;app&gt;.gronblom.dev. Only the hostnames an admin allowed the app (platform/infrastructure/configs/run/domains.yaml), in zones the cluster has certificates for. Removing one removes its route and DNS record. |
| `domains[].host` | string, required |  | The hostname: lowercase, no wildcards. E.g. `shop.gronblom.dev` |
| `domains[].service` | string, required |  | The Knative service it routes to: an HTTP function's name. It can stay private. |
| `domains[].proxied` | boolean | `false` | Behind Cloudflare's proxy (WAF, caching, Access). Not for \*.lab.gronblom.dev. |
| `env` | object |  | Plain environment variables (not secrets) for every function, e.g. {LOG\_LEVEL: info}. The deploy writes them into the functions' manifests, so a change ships with the next deploy. Each value is taken exactly as written (0.10 stays 0.10). They win over mcloud env set, which refuses the names declared here. Names are A-Z, 0-9 and \_, not starting with a digit; the platform's own (DATABASE\_URL, PORT, AWS\_\*, MAXCLOUD\_\*, K\_\*) are refused. Apps with their own manifests don't get them. |
